meta.title: Lobster Sashimi Dang Nang Seafood Feast! Dao Xanh Quan
meta.description:
Da Nang is famous for live seafood. So many restaurants to choose from!
Our family first lobster sashimi experience was at Nha Hang Dao Xanh in Da Nang. For lunch we had the whole place to ourselves!
We ordered oysters for AU$5 each and a 600g lobster sashimi. Bigger lobster will be more meatier. Not much flesh in a 600g lobster.
The prawns were my favourite! Super sweet and fleshy - just how I like it!
GeoDuck was also something not common in Sydney so I had to order but a bigger one to what we ordered would have given us more to eat.
We live to learn 
The seafood fried rice was the stomach filler but for only AU$6 it was definitely a bargain!
Can never go wrong with morning glory in asia. Cheap and delicious
It was good to try as the price was better than some on My Khe Beach but I do prefer Be Man Restaurant for the location, variety and price. Check out my previous video for my review of Be Man.

Nha Hang Dao Xanh Seafood Restaurant
124 Nguyen Van Thoai 
Bac My Phu
Ngu Hanh Son
Da Nang 550000
Vietnam
